name: opencode-fixed-inputs
description: Proves the OpenCode half of feasibility experiment S3 (fixed inputs across pause and ambient config) for M1.8 (issue #19): per-Round Agent instructions, a Skill file, and a Recipe are materialized at version A into a Round-private location; while the Round is Waiting for Input, version B is published to the mutable library location and conflicting ambient config/skill sources are planted; resuming the paused Round must still observe version A, while a brand-new Round observes version B. Depends on opencode-harness via a local file:../opencode-harness dependency (does not modify that package).
